profile.name: Alex Weeks
profile.title: IT Operations & Technology Leader
profile.tagline: Bridging business strategy and cloud engineering to deliver resilient infrastructure at scale.
profile.summary: IT operations and technology leader with experience managing technical teams, optimizing infrastructure, directing vendors, and delivering organization-wide improvements. Proven record of reducing cloud expenditure by 50%, automating workloads equivalent to two full-time employees, and leading operations supporting mission-critical systems and geographically distributed teams. Combines hands-on technical expertise with operational accountability, resource management, and cross-functional delivery.
profile.aboutSubtitle: Leading teams and operations with the same discipline.

experience.summary: IT professional with full ownership of infrastructure, automation, and vendor ecosystems, driving efficiency, reliability, and cost-effective technology solutions that support organizational growth.
highlights: Directed infrastructure optimization initiatives that reduced cloud expenditure by 50%, improving cost efficiency while maintaining operational requirements.
Designed and implemented automation across 35 business users, eliminating manual workloads equivalent to two full-time employees and increasing operational capacity.
Led delivery of 15+ cross-functional technology initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, vendors, and technical resources to achieve business objectives.
Managed technology vendor relationships, contributed to IT budget planning, and established policies and procedures supporting operational consistency, security, and governance.

experience.summary: IT operations leader with end-to-end responsibility for enterprise hardware configuration, inventory management, and logistics. Oversaw operations supporting 300 clients, 100,000+ computer configurations, $5 million in client inventory, and 12,000 shipments, maintaining 99% on-time shipping performance through hands-on leadership and operational accountability.
highlights: Led enterprise hardware configuration operations supporting 300 clients and more than 100,000 computers across 550 system images, maintaining configuration standards and coordinating team execution across diverse client environments.

Held end-to-end accountability for inventory operations managing client hardware portfolios valued at approximately $5 million, overseeing asset tracking, inventory accuracy, purchasing thresholds, and hardware availability.

Directed shipping and receiving operations handling approximately 12,000 packages valued at $1.2 million while achieving 99% on-time shipping performance through hands-on operational leadership, logistics coordination, and shipment tracking.

service.summary: Lead secure communications and data infrastructure supporting mission-critical logistics operations across expeditionary, mobile, and fixed environments. Integrate satellite communications, network engineering, cybersecurity, and technical support to maintain reliable information systems in rapidly changing operational conditions.
highlights: Served as the accountable technical authority for $3 million in communications and network assets across dispersed operational sites, ensuring operational readiness, configuration compliance, and zero loss of government property.

Designed and sustained secure network architectures connecting 10 geographically dispersed operational sites and operated 8 satellite communications platforms, enabling resilient connectivity, secure data exchange, and continuity of logistics and command operations.

Led a 14-person technical support organization, including 3 direct reports and 11 indirect personnel, delivering enterprise service desk support for logistics information systems and mission-critical user operations.

Maintained cybersecurity and configuration compliance across approximately 100 mission systems through software patching, vulnerability remediation, and security controls to protect operational networks and sustain mission availability.
